title: cli(dev): `os dev` on 18.5 runs a job handler and `onEnable` from two evaluations of the app's module, so state `onEnable` binds is absent when the job runs ("Job duly_dispatch has no data engine")
body:
repo:duly#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYdNXLejPwk9NRtzyG

Card class ① — a regression in 18.5.0 with a named public door and a repro, found by the objectstack-ai/duly#190 upgrade pass (PR objectstack-ai/duly#191).

## What happens

duly's nightly job `duly_dispatch` (a `defineJob` handler) reads a data engine that the app binds once from `defineStack({ onEnable })` (`bindDispatchEngine(ctx.ql)`, a module-scope variable in `src/jobs/dispatch.job.ts`).

| door | 18.3.0 | 18.5.0 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectstack dev` (and duly `pnpm demo`, which spawns `objectstack dev --compile`), clock at 01:00 | `sys_job_run` duly_dispatch `success`, tasks created | `failed`: "Job 'duly_dispatch' has no data engine", 4 of 4 runs, no tasks |
| `objectstack start` (serve without `--dev`), same recipe | `success` | `success` |

## Where (read from `@objectstack/cli` 18.5.0 `dist/commands/serve.js`, matches the measurement)

duly's config is a host config, so all three commands reach the `!hasAppPluginAlready && configHasMetadata` branch. Under `--dev` the #31761 block composes the dev artifact door and the wrap becomes `new AppPlugin(loadArtifactBundle(dist/objectstack.json))`: `mergeRuntimeModule` attaches the job functions from the bundled `dist/objectstack-runtime.*.mjs`, and `graftAuthoredRuntimeMembers` grafts `onEnable` from the config module. Those are two module evaluations of the same source file, so `onEnable` writes the module state of a copy the job never runs. The code comment says "both are one evaluation of the same module"; the measurement says otherwise. Without `--dev` the wrap is `new AppPlugin(config)`, one evaluation, and the job works.

## Expected

A dev boot runs an app's job functions and its `onEnable` from one module evaluation, as `os start` does and as 18.3 `os dev` did; or the platform refuses/announces the split instead of a silent per-run failure.

## Impact

Any app whose job, action or hook handler reads state its `onEnable` sets at module scope silently stops working under `os dev` only, while `os start`, the gates and CI stay green. Not measured: an artifact-only boot (`OS_ARTIFACT_URL`, no config file).

Evidence: duly project report `duly-18.5-browser-check/REPORT.md` (sections "Dispatch" and "pnpm start"), `clock/dispatch-0100.txt`, `clock/start-dispatch-0100.txt`.

Dedupe: `is:issue "no data engine"` (133 hits, none on this), `is:issue job handler module evaluation onEnable` (1 hit, #14299, unrelated), `is:issue created:>2026-11-12 os dev job handler` (22 hits, none on this); #31761 is the change, closed.
